definitions.full: H7840. shecharchoreth [ שְׁחַרְחֹר Ges § 84 b n] adjective blackish (Gann JAS 1883, Fev.-Mars. 156. no. 41 , compare Israel proper name שׁחרחר on seal = 'le brun'); — feminine שְׁחַרְחֹ֫רֶת Song 1:6 .
